nodes.label: Studio Empty WebP Delivery Plate
nodes.rationale: Compressed WebP delivery counterpart of studio-empty.png: 1672x941 RGB WebP, about 37.7 KB. Preloaded in index.html and services/index.html and painted as the .studio-background CSS layer. Documented and pixel-sampled rather than visually inspected: dark 16:9 product-studio plate with cool upper-left light, slate haze, near-black surround and polished floor; no camera, ribbons, text or logo.

nodes.label: Empty Dark Product Studio Plate
nodes.rationale: Content concept: a clean, smooth, empty studio scene with no visible equipment, camera, people, text or logo, intended as a neutral backdrop for compositing. Inferred from the recorded generation prompt and measured dark image statistics.

nodes.label: Near-Black Onyx Environment
nodes.rationale: Content concept: onyx #0A0A0A base with near-black shadows. Sampled upper-right area is approximately RGB (11,15,23), consistent with the documented unlit studio surround.

nodes.label: Cool Slate Studio Haze
nodes.rationale: Content concept: subdued blue-slate atmosphere matching the documented #536878 accent. Mean sampled RGB across a 16x9 grid is approximately (32,38,49), a dark cool cast rather than a neutral gray.

nodes.label: Upper-Left Soft White Spotlight
nodes.rationale: Content concept: soft neutral-white key light from the upper left. Sampled upper-left is approximately RGB (125,135,151) versus (11,15,23) at upper right, supporting the gradient described in the provenance prompt.

nodes.label: Dark Polished Floor With Silver Reflections
nodes.rationale: Content concept: glossy lower third with restrained silver reflections, explicitly preserved by the generation prompt. Lower samples remain dark slate, but the exact reflective detail was not visually verified.

nodes.label: Floor Horizon at 84 Percent Height
nodes.rationale: Uncertain fine-detail reading: the provenance prompt specifies a floor horizon at 84 percent of frame height. Without visual inspection this exact placement cannot be confirmed from the pixels, so the reading is marked AMBIGUOUS.

nodes.label: Ribbon-Free and Red-Glow-Free Plate
nodes.rationale: Content concept: the burgundy fabric waves and their reddish illumination were deliberately removed from studio-background.png, leaving a neutral base for code-driven atmospheric effects.

nodes.label: Lossy WebP Web-Delivery Compression
nodes.rationale: Performance role: the delivery WebP is about 37.7 KB versus about 1.49 MB for the PNG master. README notes the corresponding WebPs are the assets used by the page, around 270 KB combined.
